title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.3
body_markdown:
*released Dec 5th, 2023*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.3

* An issue in which projects that use razor files either as linked files or from shared projects has been fixed.

### Developer Community

* [Custom text rendering settings are ignored in VS2022 code windows](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Custom-fonts-ignored-in-VS2022-code-wind/10514561)
* [Wrong line size after update to 17.8.](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Wrong-line-size-after-update-to-178/10516220)
* [Android local devices stops appearing after upgrading to VS 2022 17.8.0](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Android-local-devices-stops-appearing-af/10515028)
* [After updating Visual Studio 2022 to 17.8.1 I have a problem with shared projects](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/After-updating-Visual-Studio-2022-to-17/10523348)
* [.esproj will not launch StartupCommand if in a solution folder](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/esproj-will-not-launch-StartupCommand-i/10516578)
* [remote Git operations are very slow](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/remote-Git-operations-are-very-slow/10467339)
* [VS2022 17.8: "The identifier is not defined" when evaluating locals on .NET Framework files with an unicode character](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS2022178C-The-identifier-is-not-defin/10520176)

### Known Issues

* Users who have privilege management software from Delinea installed may experience issues launching Visual Studio. Delinea is aware of this issue and has addressed it. Please contact them through <https://delinea.com/support> to get instructions on how to resolve this issue.â
